            or history_embeddings.shape != backbone.shape
            or backbone.shape[:2] != seq.shape
        ):
            raise ValueError("History residual expects matching B x L and B x L x D tensors")
        if self.history_mode == "none":
            return backbone
        if seq.shape[1] == 0:
            return backbone
        work_dtype = (
            torch.float64
            if backbone.dtype == torch.float64 or history_embeddings.dtype == torch.float64
            else torch.float32
        )
        valid = seq.ne(0)
        with torch.autocast(device_type=backbone.device.type, enabled=False):
            x = history_embeddings.to(work_dtype)
            x = x.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
            if self.history_mode == "uniform":
                # Equivalent valid-token prefix mean, including internal padding.
                mass = valid.to(work_dtype).cumsum(dim=1).unsqueeze(-1)
                pooled = x.cumsum(dim=1) / mass.clamp_min(1.0)
                pooled = pooled.masked_fill(~valid.unsqueeze(-1), 0.0)
            elif self.history_mode == "last":
